original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚伊莫州20名被绑架准服役人员获释
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚伊莫州奥韦里-奥尼查公路沿线被绑架的20名国家青年服务团（NYSC）准成员及1名乘客已重获自由。据称，在安全机构协调行动下，受害者于10月7日（周三）获释。一名国家安全局（SSS）消息人士向The ICIR证实了此次解救。事发六天前，即10月1日（周四）早上约6时30分，两辆载有准成员及其他乘客的巴士在姆巴伊托利地方政府区乌穆诺哈附近遭袭。

location.site: 奥韦里-奥尼查公路，乌穆诺哈附近
location.raw_text: Owerri-Onitsha Road in Imo State, near Umunoha in the Mbaitoli Local Government Area

key_facts.fact: 20名NYSC准成员及1名乘客在伊莫州被绑架后获释
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: TWENTY prospective National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) members and one other passenger abducted along the Owerri-Onitsha Road in Imo State have regained their freedom.

key_facts.fact: 受害者于10月7日周三在安全机构协调行动后获释
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The victims regained freedom on Wednesday, October 7, following a coordinated operation involving security agencies.

key_facts.fact: 一名SSS消息人士向The ICIR证实了获释消息
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A source in the State Security Services (SSS) confirmed the release to The ICIR on Wednesday, saying the abducted prospective corps members and the other victim had been rescued.

key_facts.fact: 两辆巴士于10月1日周四早上约6时30分在乌穆诺哈附近遭袭
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The two buses conveying the prospective corps members and other passengers were attacked at about 6:30 a.m. on Thursday, October 1, near Umunoha in the Mbaitoli Local Government Area.

uncertainties: 获释消息目前仅来自单一来源（SSS消息人士），尚缺乏交叉验证
